canonical frozen source slices (2365 unique episodes)
method.machine_first_logic: Search explicit explosion wording and exact-city context, then join candidate timestamps/context to canonical episodes; existing strict episodes are excluded from miss candidates.
method.targeted_external_logic: Candidate/date-driven search of previously used source families, especially Ukrinform, Zaporizhzhia OVA/Fedorov, Suspilne Zaporizhzhia and local media. No broad per-episode web search over all 2196 non-strict episodes.
method.timing_rule: Publication time is not treated as event time. Strict is retained when the source itself explicitly places the explosion during the alert or gives an event time inside the episode.
method.multi_episode_date_check: Dates with multiple canonical episodes were not treated as closed after one strict match; evidence was joined to episode_id.

failure_patterns.implication: The 22.11.2025 case is not an isolated instance of a date containing one retained strict episode and another qualifying episode being missed.

failure_patterns.note: Most newly confirmed misses were surfaced by Ukrinform or an Ukrinform mirror, even though Ukrinform was also used elsewhere in the canonical backfill. This indicates incomplete discovery/retention, not wholesale exclusion of the source family.

strengths: All 2365 frozen canonical episodes were available for episode-level joins.
All 169 existing strict events were mapped back to canonical episode IDs.
All six strict air-defence-positive pilot cases were rechecked.
All sensitivity-only records containing explicit explosion wording were rechecked.
Targeted external discovery concentrated on high-signal dates/source hits and multi-episode dates.
limitations: The repo does not contain a complete raw Zaporizhzhia Telegram archive or a complete log of all rejected historical source-discovery hits.
The audit did not execute unbounded web search for every one of the 2196 non-strict episodes.
A negative result therefore cannot prove the remaining non-strict universe is complete.
coverage_assessment.interpretation: The audit is sufficient to reject the 'isolated miss' hypothesis because multiple independent strict false negatives were confirmed. It is not sufficient to claim the corrected numerator is exhaustive.

qa_answer: The 2025-11-22 miss is a symptom of a broader false-negative problem in the Zaporizhzhia historical explosion backfill. Same-date multi-episode suppression is one confirmed mechanism, but not the only one.
canonical_repair_recommendation: Do not repair from this artifact automatically. First review the 12 additional confirmed misses and 4 needs_review cases, then patch canonical evidence/numerator in a separate controlled repair task.
